mechanism: Fish oil has antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties that may potentiate bleeding risk, while primaquine can cause hemolysis in G6PD-deficient patients; combined use increases bleeding tendency in susceptible individuals.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding or hemolysis; assess G6PD status before primaquine initiation; consider separating administration times and use fish oil cautiously in patients on anticoagulation therapy.
